description: This file is an HTML document that serves as the frontend interface for visualizing and interacting with database contents, including database listing, table viewing, and data presentation with dynamic behaviors.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the API and populates the sidebar with clickable database items.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading from the API and resets selection states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses tables list for the selected database, loading table names as needed.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Retrieves the list of tables for a specified database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and displays it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the fetched table data into an HTML table with headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expandability.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data or truncated version.
